place_fields.summary: Grand Safari through tiger, lion, bear and herbivore safari zones within Bannerghatta Biological Park.
place_fields.best_time: October to June is generally rewarding; early morning is preferable for cooler conditions and more active wildlife.

planning_attributes.description: Bannerghatta Biological Park is a 731.88-hectare biological park with zoo, safari, butterfly park and rescue centre units.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The biological park emerged as an independent establishment in 2002 after forest was set aside from Bannerghatta National Park for eco-recreation, eco-tourism and conservation.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The Bengaluru Urban district site lists the park about 22 km south of Bengaluru; it gives about 28 km from City Railway Station and Kempegowda Bus Station and about 60 km from Kempegowda International Airport.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The park is closed every Tuesday. Safari tickets are limited, and single-use plastic items are not permitted inside the zoo.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The official park guidance recommends comfortable shoes, water, a hat and rain protection; the zoo is a silent zone, and food or liquids should be secured because free-ranging monkeys may snatch them.
planning_attributes.local_name_variants: Bannerughatta Biological Park; Bannerghatta Biological Park; BBP
planning_attributes.notes: The official preparedness guidance says visitors may walk about 2–3 km within the zoo area; online ticket booking is recommended.

place_fields.micro_region: Banjarapalya, Agara, Kengeri Hobli, Bengaluru, Karnataka
place_fields.vibe: Hands-on animal interaction and outdoor experiential education
place_fields.summary: Animal park and educational farm where visitors interact with domestic and exotic animals and birds in an outdoor setting.
place_fields.best_time: During the published opening window of 10:30 AM–4:00 PM; pre-booking is mandatory and the farm is closed Tuesdays.

planning_attributes.description: Birds of Paradise Foundation is an animal park and experiential education initiative offering a two-hour educational tour with animals and birds across many species.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The foundation describes itself as an initiative of Pangea Flora and Fauna Consultancy LLP focused on experiential education, wildlife education and responsible human-animal coexistence.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The published address is 94/3 Banjarapalya Village, Agara, Kengeri Hobli, Bengaluru, off Kanakapura Road; the site also lists a BMTC bus route to the farm.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Pre-booking is mandatory and walk-ins are not accepted; the farm is closed Tuesdays.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Animal interactions are conducted in an educational farm setting; visitors should follow staff guidance around animals and any separately charged adventure activities.
planning_attributes.local_name_variants: Birds of Paradise Foundation; Birds of Paradise Foundation & NGO; Bird of Paradise Farm
planning_attributes.notes: The site currently advertises a two-hour educational tour and separately lists activities such as horse walk, fishing, ATV, adventure ropes, zip line and sky cycling.

place_fields.micro_region: Somanahalli Village, off Kanakapura Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka
place_fields.vibe: Interactive animal sanctuary and experiential education
place_fields.summary: Pet sanctuary offering an educational farm visit with rescued animals and birds and opportunities for guided interaction.
place_fields.best_time: The sanctuary is open daily; visiting during the published 9:00 AM–5:00 PM gate window allows the educational tour to be completed within operating hours.

planning_attributes.description: Prani – The Pet Sanctuary is an experiential education park where visitors can interact with rescued animals and birds across 40+ species.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Prani is described by its operator as an initiative of Into the Wild, a Bengaluru-based start-up focused on outdoor experiential education.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The official site gives the location as Somanahalli Village, off Kanakapura Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560082; its FAQ provides guidance on public transportation and nearest metro.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The operator asks visitors to abide by their selected visit time. Guests bringing pets must provide an updated vaccination report.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Visitors are asked to carry water; the site notes the premises are typical farm land and can become muddy during monsoon. Pet entry requires an updated vaccination report.
planning_attributes.notes: The official site currently states the educational tour is 1.5 hours and that the sanctuary is open 365 days; entry is ₹400 for visitors aged 3 years and above.
